name: agentui-builder-page
description: The builder-shaped page is repainted through update_view: the timeline advances and a question is asked ON THE PAGE (ap:question), not in prose. Asserts on tool results, never on the reply. The SAME hook is then repainted with a DIFFERENT ap:question -- one question at a time, which is how the builder asks -- and must be accepted as another update: a repaint is an ordinary tool call, not a second question the framework has to reconcile. The turn ends on a bare endTurn with no respond_to_user at all -- the model's answer to this user turn IS the page repaint, not a chat reply -- so this bundle carries no assert.agentReplyContains; the session settling at Idle (test/e2e/threadrun's wantSessionPhaseFor) is the barrier that lets the run finish before the checks below read it. Two closing read_view turns then prove the page comes back as JSX, not HTML-escaped, and that the agent's own fill of the brief hook is marked as such.
userTurns: I want an agent that summarizes my team's open pull requests every morning.

expect.userTextContains: summarizes my team's open pull requests

props.prompt: Which channel should the digest go to?

systemPromptContains: - phase: no instruction from the author (allowed: any registered component)
- brief: no instruction from the author (allowed: any registered component)
Call read_view before your first update_view
